settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: We pack every order within 1-2 working days. DHL then delivers in 1-2 working days in the Netherlands and 2-5 working days elsewhere in Europe. Shipping is always free.

settings.question: I haven't received a tracking number
settings.answer: Your DHL tracking number is emailed as soon as your order leaves our studio. Check your spam folder, or sign in to your account under the Order number tab to see the status.

settings.question: My tracking hasn't updated
settings.answer: It can take up to 24 hours before DHL shows the first scan. Still no movement after 2 working days? Message us with your order number and we'll chase DHL for you.

settings.question: I missed the delivery
settings.answer: DHL leaves a card or email and usually tries again the next working day, or brings the parcel to a nearby DHL ServicePoint. You can change the delivery moment via the DHL tracking page.

settings.question: How do I return my package?
settings.answer: You have 14 days after delivery to return an item. Read our Return & Refund Policy for the steps.
